items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: My guess would be that it was probably the very, very early Ted Lewis, Art Hickman, that type of orchestra.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Very interesting relationship there. I didn't realize it could be resolved as simply as that, and then we read through the truth. Do you remember the first band you ever heard, the first thing that might be a dance band? I'm changing our talk chronologically now to try to cover a little ground that we missed.
My guess would be that it was probably the very, very early Ted Lewis, Art Hickman, that type of orchestra.
